ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا مِنْ كينيا mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am from Kenya.
   B. I am a pupil (boy).
   C. I am a pupil (girl).
   D. My name is Ahmad.

2. Which Arabic sentence means "What is your name? (to a girl)" (1 mark)
   A. أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ
   B. اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ
   C. مَا اسْمُكِ؟
   D. أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ

3. What does the Arabic sentence أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My mother cooks.
   B. This is my father.
   C. This is my mother.
   D. I have a brother and a sister.

4. What does the Arabic sentence الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The lamp is above the table.
   B. The cat is under the bed.
   C. The book is on the table.
   D. The pen is in the bag.

5. What is phonological awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Writing quickly
   B. Knowing many words
   C. Spelling only
   D. Noticing the sounds inside words

6. How is the Arabic word اُخْرُجْ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ukhruj
   B. iftahi l-baab
   C. aghliqi l-baab
   D. uktub

7. What does the Arabic word عَيْنٌ (ʿayn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. hand
   B. eye
   C. tongue
   D. hair

8. Which Arabic sentence means "This is my hand." (1 mark)
   A. أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي
   B. أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي
   C. أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي
   D. هَذِهِ يَدِي

9. Which Arabic sentence asks 'How is the weather today?' (1 mark)
   A. kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?
   B. hal tuhibbu l-mawz?
   C. ayna l-kitaab?
   D. maa ismuka?

10. Which is a sign of fluent speaking? (1 mark)
   A. Whispering
   B. Speaking as fast as possible
   C. Long stops between words
   D. Clear sounds and a steady pace

11. What are the three parts of a short speech? (1 mark)
   A. Question, answer and test
   B. Song, dance and drum
   C. Opening, middle and closing
   D. Title, picture and page

12. How do you read the syllable نَ? (1 mark)
   A. su
   B. na
   C. tu
   D. ta

13. Which mark gives the short vowel 'a'? (1 mark)
   A. sukuun, a small circle
   B. fatHa, a small slanted line above the letter
   C. kasra, a small line below the letter
   D. Damma, a small curl above the letter

14. Which sound does the Arabic letter ذ make? (1 mark)
   A. sh as in shop
   B. dh as in this
   C. k as in kite
   D. b as in bag

15. How do you read the syllable نُ? (1 mark)
   A. bi
   B. nu
   C. la
   D. ni

16. How is the Arabic word ابْنٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ibn
   B. khaal
   C. jadd
   D. ʿamma

17. Which Arabic word means "father's brother"? (1 mark)
   A. جَدٌّ
   B. خَالَةٌ
   C. جَدَّةٌ
   D. عَمٌّ

18. In what order do you say the letters when you spell an Arabic word aloud? (1 mark)
   A. From right to left
   B. From the last letter only
   C. From left to right
   D. In any order

19. How is the Arabic word أُسْبُوعٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. amsi
   B. as-sabt
   C. usbuuʿ
   D. al-ithnayn

20. Which Arabic word means "Sunday"? (1 mark)
   A. أَمْسِ
   B. الثُّلَاثَاءُ
   C. الْأَحَدُ
   D. أُسْبُوعٌ

21. How is the Arabic word قَدَمٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. katif
   B. qadam
   C. sinn
   D. udhun

22. Which Arabic word means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. مُمْطِرٌ
   B. شَمْسٌ
   C. مُشْمِسٌ
   D. غَائِمٌ

23. How does a reading circle work? (1 mark)
   A. One learner reads for the whole hour
   B. Only the teacher reads
   C. Everyone reads silently
   D. Each learner takes a turn to read aloud

24. How is the Arabic word تَحْتَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. fii
   B. amaama
   C. ʿinda
   D. taHta

25. What is a thematic word? (1 mark)
   A. A number
   B. A very long word
   C. A word that belongs to the theme of a text
   D. A word in English

26. What is the name of the Arabic letter ص? (1 mark)
   A. nuun
   B. ghayn
   C. Saad
   D. Taa

27. Which sound does the Arabic letter ر make? (1 mark)
   A. l as in lamp
   B. a quick rolled r
   C. th as in think
   D. b as in bag

28. Which sound does the Arabic letter ت make? (1 mark)
   A. t as in tap
   B. a quick rolled r
   C. m as in mat
   D. d as in dog

29. What does the Arabic sentence الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The chair is new.
   B. The table is small.
   C. The door is big.
   D. The window is clean.

30. How is the Arabic word صَحْنٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. sahn
   B. khizaana
   C. kitaab
   D. hadiiqa

31. What does the Arabic word جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) mean? (1 mark)
   A. hand
   B. shoulder
   C. new
   D. close the door

32. What does the Arabic word عَصِيرٌ (ʿasiir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. juice
   B. no
   C. candle
   D. your turn

33. Which Arabic word means "birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. أُغْنِيَةٌ
   B. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ
   C. لَا
   D. صَدِيقٌ

34. What does the Arabic word سُكَّرٌ (sukkar) mean? (1 mark)
   A. bread
   B. sugar
   C. carrots
   D. milk

35. Which Arabic word means "fruit"? (1 mark)
   A. فَاكِهَةٌ
   B. لَذِيذٌ
   C. يَوْمٌ
   D. إِصْبَعٌ

36. Which Arabic word means "salt"? (1 mark)
   A. مِلْحٌ
   B. تُفَّاحٌ
   C. مَاءٌ
   D. بَطَاطِسُ

37. Which describing word matches yad (hand), which is feminine? (1 mark)
   A. Sagiira
   B. qawiyy
   C. jadiid
   D. kabiir

38. What does the Arabic word لِسَانٌ (lisaan) mean? (1 mark)
   A. tongue
   B. finger
   C. body
   D. ear

39. Which Arabic word means "clouds"? (1 mark)
   A. سَحَابٌ
   B. جَبَلٌ
   C. نَظِيفٌ
   D. نَهْرٌ

40. Which word means 'sun'? (1 mark)
   A. sahaab
   B. riih
   C. matar
   D. shams

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'The weather is cold.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: haadhihi yadii (2 marks)

43. Explain how to build a vocabulary bank for the theme of the body. (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Put these syllables in order to make a family word and give its meaning: khaa + lun. (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Translate into English: ukhtii taqraʾu (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: haadhihi shams (2 marks)

47. Explain why your family members are important to you. Give two examples of roles. (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: jaddii kabiir (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: al-maa'u mufiid (2 marks)

50. Rearrange the words and translate: الْعَصِيرَ / أَشْرَبُ. (2 marks) (2 marks)

51. Write a short speech of at least four sentences about your house in Arabic sounds (English letters). Give the meaning. (5 marks) (5 marks)

52. Describe two ways in which your class can look after the school environment. (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into English: raʾsii kabiir (2 marks)

54. Explain the difference between a direct question and an inferential question. Give one example of each about a text on breakfast. (4 marks) (4 marks)

55. Put the words in order and translate: كَبِيرٌ / بَيْتِي. (2 marks) (2 marks)

56. Translate into English: kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm? (2 marks)

57. Introduce yourself in Arabic (English letters are fine) with your name, that you are a pupil and that you are from Kenya, then give the English meaning. (4 marks) (4 marks)

58. Translate into English: lii yadaani (2 marks)

59. Explain the difference between kayfa haaluka? and kayfa haaluki? (2 marks) (2 marks)

60. Translate into English: ukhtii jamiila (2 marks)

61. Explain why correct spelling is important in Arabic. (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Give three qualities of neat and legible writing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

63. Explain why we celebrate special occasions and how pictures help us to understand a text. (3 marks) (3 marks)

64. Translate into English: al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — I am from Kenya.
   أَنَا مِنْ كينيا (anaa min Kiiniya) means: I am from Kenya.

2. C — مَا اسْمُكِ؟
   مَا اسْمُكِ؟ (maa ismuki?) means: What is your name? (to a girl)

3. A — My mother cooks.
   أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ (ummii tatbukhu) means: My mother cooks.

4. C — The book is on the table.
   الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila) means: The book is on the table.

5. D — Noticing the sounds inside words
   Phonological awareness is being aware of the separate sounds in words.

6. A — ukhruj
   اُخْرُجْ is read ukhruj and means go out.

7. B — eye
   عَيْنٌ (ʿayn) means eye.

8. D — هَذِهِ يَدِي
   هَذِهِ يَدِي (haadhihi yadii) means: This is my hand.

9. A — kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?
   kayfa means how, al-jawwu is the weather and al-yawm is today.

10. D — Clear sounds and a steady pace
   Fluency means smooth speech with clear sounds, steady pace and good intonation.

11. C — Opening, middle and closing
   A speech opens by greeting, gives the main information and closes by thanking.

12. B — na
   نَ is read na.

13. B — fatHa, a small slanted line above the letter
   fatHa is the mark for the short vowel a.

14. B — dh as in this
   The letter ذ makes the sound dh as in this.

15. B — nu
   نُ is read nu.

16. A — ibn
   ابْنٌ is read ibn and means son.

17. D — عَمٌّ
   عَمٌّ (ʿamm) means father's brother.

18. A — From right to left
   We spell Arabic in the direction it is written, from right to left.

19. C — usbuuʿ
   أُسْبُوعٌ is read usbuuʿ and means week.

20. C — الْأَحَدُ
   الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) means Sunday.

21. B — qadam
   قَدَمٌ is read qadam and means foot.

22. B — شَمْسٌ
   شَمْسٌ (shams) means sun.

23. D — Each learner takes a turn to read aloud
   In a reading circle each learner reads in turn.

24. D — taHta
   تَحْتَ is read taHta and means under.

25. C — A word that belongs to the theme of a text
   Thematic words belong to the main topic of a text.

26. C — Saad
   The letter ص is called Saad.

27. B — a quick rolled r
   The letter ر makes the sound a quick rolled r.

28. A — t as in tap
   The letter ت makes the sound t as in tap.

29. C — The door is big.
   الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baabu kabiir) means: The door is big.

30. A — sahn
   صَحْنٌ is read sahn and means plate.

31. C — new
   جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) means new.

32. A — juice
   عَصِيرٌ (ʿasiir) means juice.

33. B — عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ
   عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ (ʿiid miilaad) means birthday.

34. B — sugar
   سُكَّرٌ (sukkar) means sugar.

35. A — فَاكِهَةٌ
   فَاكِهَةٌ (faakiha) means fruit.

36. A — مِلْحٌ
   مِلْحٌ (milh) means salt.

37. A — Sagiira
   yad is feminine, so it takes the describing word ending in -a.

38. A — tongue
   لِسَانٌ (lisaan) means tongue.

39. A — سَحَابٌ
   سَحَابٌ (sahaab) means clouds.

40. D — shams
   shams means sun.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: al-jawwu baarid. The weather is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Write each new word with its sound and meaning, add a small drawing, and keep the words on cards or a page for practice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: khaa-lun (mother's brother).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: My sister reads.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: They love and care for us. For example parents work, cook and pay for school; grandparents share stories and advice; children help at home.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for love and care, 2 marks for two correct roles.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: My grandfather is old (big in age).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water is useful (good for you).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: أَشْرَبُ الْعَصِيرَ. I drink juice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. ismii Amina. haadhaa baytii. fii baytii matbakh. shukran li-istimaaʿikum. (Peace be upon you. My name is Amina. This is my house. In my house there is a kitchen. Thank you for listening.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a greeting, 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the topic sentence, 1 mark for a detail and 1 mark for the closing thanks.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees; put rubbish in bins; keep water clean; sweep the compound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way and 1 mark for a reason.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: My head is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: A direct question has its answer in the text, for example 'What does she drink?' An inferential question needs clues, for example 'Is it morning?'.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each definition and 1 mark for each suitable example.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ. My house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: How is the weather today?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: ismii Wanjiku. anaa tilmiidha. anaa min Kiiniya. My name is Wanjiku. I am a pupil. I am from Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meaning.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: kayfa haaluka? is said to a boy or man. kayfa haaluki? is said to a girl or woman. Both mean 'How are you?'.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy and girl endings and 1 mark for the meaning.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: My sister is beautiful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: A missing letter or a wrong dot can change the word, so the reader may not understand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a change in the word and 1 mark for understanding.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: Letters of the correct shape and same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; small spaces between words.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

63. (3 marks)
   Answer: Celebrations bring people together and give joy. Pictures show what a text is about and act as clues to new words.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for celebrations and 2 marks for pictures as clues.

64. (2 marks)
   Answer: The pen is in the bag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
